comment:
Dr. RJ is a caring professor; over time, she changed my opinion by adapting to the new class she taught and showing her care. Her lectures can be a bit scatterbrained, but she's accessible outside of class and nice overall. 

Only thing is her grading can be confusing sometimes and nitpicky, but she also curves and grades u off your growth!

Dr. R-J is awesome. She has a lot of super cool interests that she loves to share with her students. I had her for Food Microbiology. I'm not going to lie, it was a lot of work, but the class is super interesting and I am glad that I took it.

Dr. RJ is kind, caring, and super smart. I loved her class and would recommend her class to anyone who is curious and excited to learn. Her exams are fair and you get to choose your own lab project. She is an amazing person and a fantastic professor.

RJ explained confusing topics in a clear and easy to follow manner. She answered any and all questions students had. During lab she offered tips on how to effectively complete the experiment. She was accessible outside of class and very helpful when I met with her. In her tests, she asked students to apply concepts rather than memorize information.
Whatever you do, do not take her class. She grades very harshly and is very specific.

Dr. RJ is a very kind professor who has great office hours and availability. Her class lectures move really slowly in comparison to the exams- the difficulty of the exams don't reflect the topics covered in class. Expect to put in a lot of time to prepare for exams, as well as a lot of time out of class for weekly class and lab assignments.

A lot of homework, reading, and assignments for lab. Very longwinded and talks in circles a lot. Isn't very clear in her lectures. She does curve your overall grade if you show improvement which helps a lot. Takes in feedback from students.

Dr. RJ is very thorough in teaching her material, but also assigns a lot of busy work that can get really repetitive over time. The curriculum for this class is also set up with a sizeable amount of small assignments/labwork that can chip away at your grade, and her tests are heavily application-focused. She is pretty hilarious, which helps a bit.

Dr. RJ's class was definitely difficult. She cares a lot about her students and really wants you to learn, but tends to do that by assigning a very heavy workload. Exams were all based on application of the material learned, so studying can be difficult. All in all she's a nice person and rewards students for their hard work.

She's amazing, she is a little scattered but that is because she is always thinking. She is always there to help you and loves to talk to students. I had trouble with Bio and her helping me has changed my hate for bio turn into a love for bio. She makes me consider having bio as a minor/major. I recommend her but she expects you to work hard too.

Dr. R-J is amazing! Not sure why people said she was boring. She knows how to lead a discussion in class. She's also super clear when she explains concepts and if you don't understand she'll find another way to explain it to you until you understand the topic. She's always willing to meet to review material so take advantage of that!

Nicest lady, but is really scatterbrained. No doubt that she knows what she's saying and is always willing to help students out, but have always found myself more confused after she explains something than I was beforehand. Exams were decent, but she was a ridiculous grader...was frustrated at class 100% of the time

Didn't learn much in her class she put too much emphasis on real world applications everything she taught was through examples, in class work was easy,when it came to tests they were ridiculously hard, like she tries to make them as hard as possible, what she teaches in class alone is nowhere near sufficient enough to do well on tests

Dr. RJ was a great teacher. Went however slow it took to make sure everyone understood the material and assigned just the right amount of homework to reinforce my knowledge but not to be obnoxious. Tests were straightforward. Interesting material. I enjoyed the class.

Just took professor RJ for Genetics and it was easily the hardest class i have ever taken. Her tests are extremely difficult and none of the questions are on the material itself just practical applications of it. She isn't kidding when she says to do the book problems. Difficult to take notes in class. She does LOVE genetics though so u will learn.

Dr. Runyen-Janecky was an excellent Lab professor who seemed genuinely interested in the work and was pretty helpful. It is a challenging class and she is a hard grader on lab reports. The first lab report is always a pretty low grade (like a C) and by the end of it you'll probably get A's and B's. Overall I liked her, and I would take her again.
i thought she was a very good teacher. it was really important to go to class and close pay attention, but if you do and you study hard for the exams, it is very possible to get the grade you want.
I think everyone likes her as a person, and her research seminars are good...but class is boring. Whatever you do, don't take 201 early in the day, or you will fall asleep.

She's a great teacher.  She is very enthusiastic about the subject matter and she is always willing to give practical examples of application.  She is also very helpful.  One suggestion...DEFINITELY ask questions.  She is always willing to answer them!
Awesomee professor. Very invested in her students. Makes me wish i had made Bio a minor.
Helpful, but the tests were impossible to study for...simply knowing the information was not enough, and while the concept was good, she did not give the tools to accomplish it.
R-J is a really nice professor who seems to know what she's talking about.  The class itself is boring but she makes it a lot more interesting and she's not really that hard.
A great teacher, really nice and completely willing to help out students! Very fair, and really knows her stuff!
A lot of work, but she's a great teacher and very helpful.  Truly wants her students to do well.
No Comments
fair, energetic, and interesting....her class isn't very difficult at all and she's very nice
